title: hieracium laevigatum subsp. rigidum
intro: Hieracium laevigatum subsp. rigidum, commonly known as hawkweed, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of hawkweed include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and astringent, making it useful for treating skin conditions like wounds and eczema. Hawkweed contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
